text:
Rina: Quick alert for month close  a EUR invoice for Vega Labs was recognized at the billing system's auto-rate instead of the contracted FX rate, causing recognized revenue to be off.
Tom: Do you have the invoice id and numbers?
Rina: INV-2026-8822. Lines show: 
```
2026-03-11 hosted-inference vega@vega.io  14,000 tokens  charge_eur=1400.00  billed_usd=1504.20  contracted_rate=1.08  used_rate=1.0743
```
fx-bot: FX rate snapshot 2026-03-11 USD/EUR = 1.0743 (source: internal-fx).
Sasha: Using contracted_rate 1.08 would have produced billed_usd=1512.00, so revenue is understated by 7.80 USD? Wait math check.
Eli: From FP&A  small amount but our policy is to correct systemic errors affecting revenue recognition. Do we treat as rounding or book an adjusting JE?
Tom: Billing log shows the invoice used live FX feed. Contract flagged for fixed FX in customer record but billing job BJ-402 didn't read the flag due to a schema rename. Ops ticket OP-5620 opened.
Rina: Proposal: simple correcting JE to align recognized USD to contracted rate. Amount difference = +7.80 USD; JE: debit 4001 (Revenue) 7.80; credit 2102 (Accrued Credits) 7.80. Reversal not needed.
Sasha: Accounting OK with JE since < $1k and immaterial; will post JE-2026-03-VEG-05 and attach OP-5620 + invoice.
Eli: FP&A approves. Also recommend a checklist item to validate contract FX flags before invoice runs.
Tom: I'll patch BJ-402 and add a test for the flag. Will update when OP-5620 closed.
Rina: Thanks all  please note JE id in the close pack once posted. :white_check_mark:
